name: Equestrian Land Developments
tagline: Specialising in the Design and Construction of Quality Equestrian Facilities.

shop._help: CHECKOUT SETUP: paste a Stripe Payment Link (https://buy.stripe.com/...) for each product (create them in the Stripe Dashboard under Payment Links). Card, Apple Pay and Google Pay are all handled by Stripe. If a link is blank, that product page shows an 'Order by email' button instead.

contact_form._help: Optional. Paste a form endpoint (e.g. https://formspree.io/f/xxxx) to show an enquiry form on the Contact page. Leave blank to show phone/email only.

chat._help: Website chat assistant. With 'endpoint' blank it runs in TRIAL mode: instant answers from the FAQ and pages, no AI, no cost. To switch on the AI assistant, deploy chat-server/ (see README) and paste its URL here, e.g. https://eld-chat.onrender.com/chat
chat.greeting: G'day! I'm the ELD website assistant. Ask me about arena construction, surfaces, maintenance or the Spread-a-bar®.
suggestions: How much does an arena cost?
How long does a build take?
